meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,节省输入开销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用 AI 工具时觉得上下文太占空间、又想保留关键信息
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a terse format to cut input costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want smaller context without losing key details

howto.what: 将 CLAUDE.md、待办事项、偏好等自然语言文件压缩成简短的口语化格式,以节省输入token。代码块、行内代码、URL、路径、命令、技术术语等原样保留。压缩后覆盖原文件,备份保存在独立目录的 FILE.original.md 中。
howto.when: 当用户输入 `/caveman-compress <文件路径>` 命令,或说出“压缩记忆文件”等请求时触发。

say.text: 把 CLAUDE.md 压成穴居人格式
say.note: 会覆盖原文件并在备份目录保留备份。
触发技能对记忆文件执行压缩。
对指定的待办文件进行压缩。

howto.what_en: Compresses natural-language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman-style brevity to cut input tokens. Code, URLs, paths, commands, and structure are preserved exactly. Overwrites original; readable backup saved as FILE.original.md in an out-of-tree backup dir.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user runs `/caveman-compress <filepath>` or asks to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Overwrites the original and creates a backup.
Runs the compression skill on the memory file.
